card.name: Linking words in opioid CNS-depressant warnings
card.fires_on: The word "and" in "(including alcohol and illicit drugs)" within opioid label warnings about use with benzodiazepines or other CNS depressants. It also fires on linking words like "with" in co-administration phrases.

modes.label: Alcohol and illicit drugs
modes.description: The word "and" joining alcohol to illicit drugs in the boxed warning about combined use with CNS depressants.
modes.example: (including alcohol<< and>> illicit drugs). Advise patients not to

modes.label: Co-administered with
modes.description: The word "with" after co-administered, before other agents that depress breathing.
modes.example: when opioids were co-administered<< with>> other agents that depress respiration.

modes.label: Stray punctuation or digits
modes.description: Occasional odd hits on a digit in an age range or on "e.g.," before example drug classes.
